'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Mitch Nieland DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Tilt-a-whirl. Mitch Nieland, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2013 form. Username blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
